facts.fact: The Ministries of Social Affairs and Health and the National Center for Informatics signed a framework agreement on 28 November 2022 to share data digitally between the ministries and bodies under them, so users need not supply data held by others.
facts.system: Framework agreement on intangible data exchange

facts.fact: The Minister of Health said 92 health facilities using the Labes card had carried out more than 6 million data exchange operations with the National Health Insurance Fund (CNAM).

note: The Labes fact has as_of taken from the document's published date (2022-11-28), as the minister's statement is undated.
